en: "My brother's grocery has hardly anything left to sell, eh..."{KP}"With so little stock, my brother must be smiling on the outside and crying on the inside!"{KP}"If only we could grow our local specialty, {bb}daikon{ww}, at least,"{KP}"but with the fields in that state..."

jp:
「ようやく　この八百屋も
　はんじょう　しはじめた！」
en: "At last, this grocery is starting to do good business!"
